patterns.note: Content is structured within a rigid grid system, often enclosed by bracketed borders, mimicking a terminal interface.
Nearly all text, from headings to body copy and navigation, consistently uses a monospaced font.
A limited palette of off-white, dark grey, and a vibrant reddish-orange accent is used to maintain a stark, high-contrast terminal aesthetic.
A compact navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, providing persistent access to main sections.
Extensive use of ASCII art to create visual elements such as maps, dividers, and decorative borders throughout the page.

technique_notes: The entire site is designed to emulate a retro command-line interface, using monospaced fonts, bracketed UI elements, and ASCII art for visual components.
Pixelated display text and logos are rendered using a canvas element or similar technique to achieve a blocky, low-resolution aesthetic.
A fixed-position navigation bar is implemented to stick to the top of the screen after initial scroll, providing continuous access to main page anchors.

design_tokens.type_scale: A consistent monospaced font is used across all text, with hero titles rendered in a large, pixelated style (~4-5x body) and smaller uppercase labels for navigation and section headers.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced, with clear vertical separation between content blocks and a consistent horizontal padding within the main content area.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its uncompromising and meticulously executed retro terminal aesthetic, using ASCII art, pixelated typography, and bracketed UI elements to create a unique, interactive command-line experience rather than a typical modern web page.
